designationHistory.name: Pathfinder Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt established the Pathfinder Reservation on the Pathfinder Reservoir site by Executive Order 1032 on February 25, 1909, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Pathfinder National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Wikisource: Executive Order 1032, Feb. 25, 1909, establishing seventeen reservoir-site bird reservations including Pathfinder, Wyo.
T. S. Palmer, National Reservations for the Protection of Wild Life, USDA Biological Survey Circular 87 (1912), table of bird reservations
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7425, Aug. 1, 1936, Establishing the Pathfinder Wildlife Refuge (revokes the order establishing the Pathfinder Reservation)

review.note: Draft date "3725" was parsed from EO 3725 (1922), which revoked part of the reservation. Original establishment is EO 1032 (TR, 1909). FDR re-established it as Pathfinder Wildlife Refuge by EO 7425 on Aug. 1, 1936.
